enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Wisdom +6: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +6 Insight bonus to Wisdom.
Quality Will Save +3: This item gives a +3 Quality bonus to your Will saves.
Profane Well Rounded +3: +3 Profane bonus to all abilities.
Healing Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by +15 (Exceptional bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Mythic Belt Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
